breakdown.description: Large pressure drops in gases cause significant density changes
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly identifies that the pressure drop from 10 bar to 1 bar causes 'substantial density variation' and rejects the constant density of 1.225 kg/m^3. It recommends using variable local density via integration of rho * u * dA, matching the ground truth.
